queries_run: Hyatt Hotels third quarter 2026 results RevPAR growth segment
Hyatt outlook 2026 2027 lodging demand RevPAR forecast
Hyatt market share pricing trend 2026 luxury lodging

findings.claim: Q3 2026 comparable system-wide hotels RevPAR +7.2% YoY; gross fees +15.2% to $327M; 美國 RevPAR +8.2%（含 FIFA 世界盃與猶太節日時點）
findings.excerpt: comparable system-wide hotels RevPAR increased 7.2%, compared to the third quarter of 2025

findings.claim: 全包式度假村（Distribution 段）Net Package RevPAR -2.5%，主因墨西哥需求下滑；颶風 Melissa 關閉牙買加飯店，Distribution 段 Adjusted EBITDA 下滑；預期 Q4 Net Package RevPAR 回正
findings.excerpt: Net Package RevPAR decreased 2.5%, compared to the third quarter of 2025, primarily reflecting lower demand for travel to certain destinations in Mexico, partially offset by growth in the Caribbean and Europe.

findings.claim: Hyatt 將 2026 全年 comparable system-wide RevPAR 成長指引上調至 5%–5.5%（7 月為 3.5%–4.5%，Q1 初始 2%–4%）；美國 RevPAR 預期 +5%–6%
findings.source: Skift, Hyatt Raises Outlook, but Its All-Inclusives Lag
findings.excerpt: The company raised its full-year forecast for RevPAR, and now expects it to grow 5% to 5.5% in 2026, up from the 3.5% to 4.5% range it gave in July.

findings.claim: Q3 美國 RevPAR +8.2%，約 50bp 來自世界盃；管理層歸因於高端旅客韌性；Q2 中東衝突拖累 RevPAR 約 110bp；Q3 中東與非洲 -0.7%
findings.excerpt: Executives attributed the performance to the resilience of "premium travelers."

findings.claim: Q3 豪華飯店帶動成長；市占與定價無直接數據，僅有產業『分化』評論（高端優於平價）

note: 未找到 2027 展望、Lodging TAM 成長共識、具體市占數字（第4類查詢未執行）；Hyatt 營收段（Owned&leased／Distribution／管理加盟費）逐段僅 Distribution 與 Owned&leased 有 Q3 EBITDA 方向。
